destination.name: Ingham
destination.tagline: A sugar town with Italian roots, close to waterfalls and Hinchinbrook Island
destination.description: Ingham is a town of about 4,500 on the Bruce Highway between Townsville and Cairns, with a strong Italian heritage from migrants who came to work the sugar cane. Its TYTO Wetlands have an observation tower and boardwalks, and the visitor centre is on Cooper Street. Wallaman Falls nearby has a 268 m main drop, the tallest single drop in Australia. The Thorsborne Trail on Hinchinbrook Island is reached by ferry from Cardwell or Lucinda.

goodToKnow.title: Stop on the Bruce Highway
goodToKnow.detail: Ingham is about 75 to 80 minutes north of Townsville and three hours south of Cairns, and Brisbane to Cairns coaches stop here.

goodToKnow.title: Visit the info centre first
goodToKnow.detail: Hinchinbrook Visitor Information Centre on Cooper Street is open daily 9am to 4pm, at the western end of town near the TYTO Wetlands.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} is the drier, cooler part of the year, before the heavy summer rain.
